Events & Notifications

Domain events decouple side effects — an in-app notification, an email, and a live Socket.IO push — from the controller code that triggers them.

    Where ticket.service.js and comment.service.js call emit() — always after the write succeeds, carrying whatever payload the listeners need.

  • Listeners as Independent Modules

    Registering every listener with a single side-effect import, wired up wherever the app itself loads.

  • In-App Notifications

    The first of three channels reacting to the same events: a Notification row per event, and why a listener failing here must never affect the request.

  • Email via SMTP and Mailpit

  • Testing Events

    Spying on the shared emitter instead of mocking it, and the extra Prisma calls comment.service.js's tests now need to mock.
